name: Matter budget and status summary
summary: The responsible partner sees one matter whole: scope, phases against their dates, the budget against fees to date and the projected total, a red, amber or green status with the rule behind it, risks and next actions with owners. Built from the time export and the matter plan, never a view on the merits.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own rules for prepared reporting: figures tied to the firm's own records, ratings set by stated rules, every gap written as a question for a named role, nothing on the merits, and a person who decides and sends.

sources.contribution: A one-matter status report with red, amber or green ratings and the cause behind any that is not green, budget set beside spend to date and a projected total, finished and coming milestones kept apart, and risks and actions each carrying an owner.

A dated header naming the reader and how far the report may go, budget lines with baseline, spend, forecast to complete and variance, a list of decisions waiting on someone, and a closing list of the records the report drew on.
